properties.description: A capability proven only on a rig says so; ONE real check ends the simulation-only claim (reaching reality must show, since leaving the rig is the point of the progression); a passing check naming no environment is UNPLACED and explicitly not assumed real — unknown is not simulated either; and a capability with nothing passing is absent from the report entirely rather than appearing as proven-nowhere, because that is unverified_capability's question (crates/reflow2-core/tests/evidence.rs, 4 cases)
properties.name: A capability proven only on a rig says so, and one check ends the claim
